title: std::memcpy may overflow 32-byte Chunk.id field if id string exceeds 32 characters
detail: src/aurora/aurora-storage/src/chunk.cpp:L27 calls std::memcpy(c.id, id.c_str(), id.size()) where c.id is declared as char id[32]; if id.size() exceeds 32 the copy writes past the end of the array, overflowing into adjacent struct members. No length guard on id is visible in make_chunk().
